title: Soft backend: C_GenerateKeyPair for ECC and RSA
description: wolfCrypt has wc_ecc_make_key and wc_MakeRsaKey but C_GenerateKeyPair in wp11_pkcs11.c is only implemented for the wolfHSM backend. Add soft-backend key generation: generate key with wolfCrypt, DER-encode it, store as a wp11_soft_key_t in g_keys[], and return public key attributes. Should support CKM_EC_KEY_PAIR_GEN (P-256, P-384) and CKM_RSA_PKCS_KEY_PAIR_GEN.
